$$ \chi_{\mathrm{arc}}(\mathrm{PG}(2,q)) = \begin{cases} q+1 & \text{if } q \text{ is odd or } q=2 \\ q & \text{if } q \text{ is even and } q \ge 4 \end{cases} $$
This formula is mathematically accurate based on established results in finite geometry.
